title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kumaran and Sarasu enjoy their beach outing while Kandhasamy delights in his new eyeglasses. Then, the family surprises Kumaran and Sarasu with a special anniversary celebration.

title: Thaai Maaman
episodeTitle: Mayandi Shares His Joy With Pechi
description: Pechi questions Kaliyammal about the family's past rivals and enemies. Mayandi shares his joy with Pechi as Poongodi calls him 'Mama', and both are pleased by her transformation.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi urges Paraman to join the Panchayat election to serve the public. Kalamma tries to get Paraman to withdraw, but he refuses unless Siddharth drops out, infuriating her.
